candidates.change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.value == 10 ether);' with 'require(msg.value == 0);' so that fallback no longer requires exactly 10 ether.
Replace 'require(msg.value == 10 ether);' with 'require(msg.value == 1 ether);' so that fallback requires a different non-zero amount.
Delete the require statement for msg.value check so that fallback accepts any amount of ether.
Replace 'require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);' with 'require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime);' so that calls in the same block as the last are allowed.
Delete the require statement for timestamp check so that fallback can be called multiple times in the same block.
Replace 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;' with 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;' so that the timestamp restriction is effectively disabled, allowing calls in the same block.
Replace 'if(block.number % 15 == 0)' with 'if(block.number % 15 != 0)' so that ether is transferred on non-multiples of 15 instead.
Delete the entire if-block so that ether is never transferred to the sender.
Replace 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance);' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(1 ether);' so that only 1 ether is transferred instead of the entire balance.
